topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 40 project-authored contract(s) across 7 chain(s); 1 ERC20 token, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; role-gated via AccessControl; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 3 common project-authored base contract(s) (securedaddresslock, revestaccesscontrol, revestreentrancyguard). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
